en: A black-and-white panoramic view over a small town with low wooden and masonry houses, a few larger multi‑storey buildings in the background, and tree‑lined streets. The image has the visual style of an early 20th‑century photograph printed as a postcard. In the lower right corner, white caption text identifies the scene as a panorama of Nyköping, viewed from a church tower.
